script.text:
set -euxo pipefail
apt-get update && apt-get install -y osmium-tool gdal-bin curl git ca-certificates
curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh
export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"
mkdir -p /var/tmp/geodashing-work
cd /var/tmp/geodashing-work
git clone --branch feat/new-road-algo --single-branch https://github.com/lucienve/geodashing-v2.git repo || git clone https://github.com/lucienve/geodashing-v2.git repo
cd repo
uv sync --no-dev
curl -L --fail --retry 5 --retry-delay 5 https://planet.openstreetmap.org/pbf/planet-latest.osm.pbf -o /var/tmp/geodashing-work/planet-latest.osm.pbf
uv run --no-sync python -m backend.scripts.prepare_roads --input /var/tmp/geodashing-work/planet-latest.osm.pbf --output /var/tmp/geodashing-work/world_drivable_roads.gpkg --delete-input --upload-gcs
